checks.matching: Requires structurally complete function, one CFG block, exactly two assignments then return; four distinct parameter/local symbols; declared NumPy imports; one eig result unpacked into ordered values/vectors; argmax(abs(values)); same selected index and full unstrided vector column. Extra effects/control flow or mismatches abstain.
checks.projection_scope: Seven source-bound FOL predicates; six corresponding Lean definition bindings. Existing SMT route handles only reviewed abstract index/shape templates; compound NumPy semantics are not silently translated into trusted SMT assumptions.
checks.replay: Consumer persists source and producer hashes, full reports and bounded planning summary; validation re-formalizes exact source/path, compares all report bytes, recomputes summary, rejoins world/metadata records, and rechecks source/producers after replay.
checks.runtime_identity: Declared imports and matching syntax do not prove callable identity, array types, effects, exceptions, aliasing, floating-point behavior, or tolerance. These remain explicit pending obligations.
checks.summary_accounting: Consumer counts full contract population, selects available per-report bounded rows, and records both upstream and consumer truncation. Dropped rows increment omitted counts; whole summary is capped at8192 bytes.
